One more instruction (VERY IMPORTANT)

AI often stops after creating the UI. Add this at the end of your prompt:

Do NOT generate only the UI.

Implement the complete logic.

Every onclick event must work.

Every page must have its own route.

Every component must be connected.

Do not leave TODO comments.

Do not leave placeholder functions.

Do not leave fake buttons.

Complete the entire application before stopping.

If a feature cannot be completed in one response, continue generating automatically until the project is fully functional.

One practical note

Even with a strong prompt, VS Code AI cannot reliably generate an entire commercial-scale application in a single prompt. Large apps should be built incrementally:

  1. Generate the project architecture and routing.

  2. Generate each page with working functionality.

  3. Connect all pages.

  4. Implement state management and backend integration.

  5. Polish the UI and animations.

This approach produces much more reliable, maintainable code than asking for the entire app in one shot.
